description:
HubSpot is looking for an experienced leader to join our high performing Scaled Contract Management organization. This team is responsible for helping customers serviced by HubSpot’s Scaled Customer Success Team to navigate all of their billing, contract, and renewal inquiries. 

As a Manager on our Scaled Contract Management Team, you will be responsible for hiring, training, coaching, and managing a team of new and established Contract Managers in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. We are looking for someone that is effective, adaptable, flexible and analytical. As our customer base continues to grow, the Contract Management team is tasked with creating the optimal path to helping our customers grow through both their contract terms and the use of HubSpot’s software platform while also ensuring their current growth strategy extends into the future.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead a team of Contract Managers who are responsible for overseeing and processing any contract and billing questions for a high volume of customers
  • Manage day-to-day operations, goal setting, career development, performance management, and the growth of team members
  • Build strong working relationships with other managers, directors and executives across the business
  • Proactively identify areas for innovation and improvement within the Contract Management Team and drive collaborative developments within our existing playbooks
  • Analyze customer and performance data to make informed decisions about operational and procedural changes
  • Serve as a coach and a leader, helping to develop the skills of your team so they are able to achieve their metrics and career goals
  • Maximize efficiency in a constantly changing and growing environment where the process is fluid and creative and unique solutions are desired

We're looking for people who have:

  • 2-5 years of management experience, ideally with renewals teams
  • Clear history of coaching and developing individual contributors 
  • Passion and commitment for helping customers succeed and grow 
  • Strong analytical skills to identify team trends and patterns to drive results
  • Familiarity of interaction between contracts, terms of service and legal requirements
  • Clear and articulate communication skills with the ability to effectively drive a negotiation
  • Phenomenal organizational skills and attention to detail with a track record of driving efficiencies
  • Experience navigating and resolving customer escalations
  • Ability to communicate effectively in small and large groups
  • Intellectual curiosity and a resourceful approach to problem solving
  • Passion for helping individual performers meet their personal and professional goals
  • Personal responsibility to achieve team goals

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. HubSpot is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.
